purpose: Teach: 洗浄/貸付/清算/通商/投機/知名度/推計/税込み

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 工場の洗浄プロセスを見直しましょう
lines.en: Let's review the factory cleaning process.
lines.style: Crisp, purposeful opening. Clear agenda-setting tone. Direct eye contact level. Measured pace, no hesitation. The confidence of someone leading a meeting.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。福利厚生の貸付制度を強化しました
lines.en: Yes. I've strengthened our employee welfare lending programme.
lines.style: Attentive and ready. Slight lean forward. Respectful cadence — not rushed, showing he's thought this through. Warm formality between colleagues.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 決算前の清算をしっかり進めましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure we complete the pre-settlement accounts carefully.
lines.style: Steady, methodical tone. Slight emphasis on thoroughness without sounding urgent. Eyes forward. The rhythm of someone who knows what precision costs and insists on it anyway.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。通商代表団と意見交換しました
lines.en: Yes. I've exchanged views with the trade delegation.
lines.style: Factual, efficient. Brief pause after the affirmation — giving weight to the update. Calm confidence. Not elaborating, trusting she'll ask if she needs detail.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社員が投機に走らないよう啓発しましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure staff understand the risks of speculation.
lines.style: Firm but not stern. Slight care in the delivery — this is about protecting people, not punishing them. Quiet emphasis on 'understand'. Deliberate pace.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の知名度向上を進めております
lines.en: Yes. We're making progress on raising company awareness.
lines.style: Steady, slightly warm undertone. Gentle emphasis on the ongoing work. Not defensive — owning the process. The tone of someone reporting progress without overselling it.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 需要を推計してから生産計画を立てましょう
lines.en: Let's estimate demand first, then draw up the production plan.
lines.style: Logical, methodical. Slight pause between the two actions — marking the sequence. Clear conviction that order matters. The voice of someone who's learned this the hard way.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。価格は税込みで表記いたします
lines.en: Yes. We'll display all prices tax-inclusive.
lines.style: Affirmative and closing. Lighter, settling tone — this is confirmation, not debate. Small nod in the voice. Wrapping up the meeting with finality.
